detail.longDescription: I'm getting the error The asset "./components/index.jsx.js"| is not present in the asset pipeline. Error is triggered by this javascript_include_tag : <%= javascript_include_tag 'components/index.jsx' %> The file is present under /app/javascript/components/index.jsx In package.json my build script calls esbuild as follows: "build": "esbuild app/javascript/\*.\* --bundle --sourcemap --outdir=app/assets/builds --public-path=assets --loader:.js=jsx --platform=node", I don't know, why rails is looking for the double extension jsx.js ?
